seo.title: Services — Siha Span
seo.description: Four areas of practice: Strategy & Growth, Health Facility Development, Clinical Governance & Quality, and Specialised Assignments for the healthcare ecosystem.

head.heading: Four areas of practice.
head.lede: Each engagement is scoped to the problem in front of you, drawing on whichever of these areas it touches.

items.title: Strategy & Growth
items.body: Market entry, service-line expansion and positioning for providers, insurers and health-tech companies deciding where to invest next.

items.title: Health Facility Development
items.body: Feasibility, planning and project oversight for new and expanding health facilities, from concept through to commissioning.

items.title: Clinical Governance & Quality
items.body: Governance frameworks, quality systems and compliance support that hold up to regulatory and accreditation scrutiny.

items.title: Specialised Assignments
items.body: Focused, time-bound assignments for government agencies, NGOs and foundations — research, evaluation and technical support.

cta.heading: Have a healthcare challenge that needs a systems-level solution?
cta.text: Tell us about the challenge and we’ll help you scope the right engagement.
